$comment: Taxonomy-valued fields carry an x-taxonomy annotation naming the dimension in factory/policies/taxonomy.yml. The runtime validates those values against that file at write time; enums are never inlined here to avoid drift between the schema and the taxonomy (architecture §8).
title: Task Result
description: Structured return from a worker run. Workers return schema-validated results, never transcripts (architecture §15.4); the final message is data, not prose.

structured_output.description: Task-specific payload; shape is defined by the task spec's output_schema_ref, not by this envelope.

path.description: Under the task's artifact home, state/artifacts/<task_id>/ — relative to it by preference. JSON Schema cannot express "inside this directory", so the gate is the enforcer: it resolves each path in the home and blocks with reason 'artifacts-missing' if one is elsewhere or absent.

diff_lines_changed.description: Excludes lockfiles/generated files, per the coder diff cap (agent-constraints.md).

notes.description: Short structured note, e.g. reason for stopping at a budget cap.
